parsed.doc_summary: Berkeley Rent Board page on security deposits: describes state-law deposit caps under AB 12 (effective 2024-07-01) and Berkeley Rent Ordinance deposit interest requirement.

rules.title: California security deposit cap (AB 12) and return rules
rules.requirement: Landlords may generally charge a security deposit of no more than one month's rent for furnished or unfurnished units; small landlords (two properties, four or fewer units total, natural person/family trust/qualifying LLC owner) may charge up to two months. Deposits must be returned within 21 days with an itemized statement.
rules.key_value: 1 month's rent (2 months for qualifying small landlords)
rules.quoted_span: Starting July 1, 2024, many landlords may only charge one month's rent for unfurnished and furnished units
rules.effective_date_note: Per Berkeley Rent Board page describing AB 12 changes.
rules.exemptions: Two-month cap for landlords owning only two rental properties with no more than four units total, held by natural person, family trust, or LLC with all natural-person members.

coverage.landlord_size_condition: owner of 2 rental properties with no more than 4 residential units total (for 2-month cap)

rules.interaction: Berkeley adds a local interest requirement on deposits for Rent Ordinance-covered units.

rules.title: Berkeley security deposit interest requirement
rules.requirement: For units fully or partially covered by the Berkeley Rent Ordinance, landlords must pay tenants interest on security deposits at the end of each year, with a prorated amount if the tenant moves out earlier.
rules.quoted_span: For tenancies in units fully or partially covered by Berkeley's Rent Ordinance, landlords must pay tenants interest on their security deposit at the end of each year and a prorated amount if the tenant moves out before the end of the year.
rules.coverage_conditions: Units fully or partially covered by the Berkeley Rent Ordinance.
rules.interaction: Operates alongside state cap in Civ. Code § 1950.5.
rules.conflict_note: Document does not state the municipal code section; ch. 13.76 is the Rent Ordinance chapter inferred, not stated.
